thread:
alerts-bot: Automated detection: public GCS bucket binding found for bucket `redwood-backups-logs-prod`. IAM binding detected: `allUsers` -> `roles/storage.objectViewer`. Also flagged: KMS key `projects/rdw-infra/locations/global/keyRings/backup-keys/cryptoKeys/rdw-backup-key` has a broad binding (looks like a terraform mistake). Possible data exposure of logs/backups. Details: 1.5M objects, last modified within 48h. Please triage ASAP.

maya: seeing this now. thanks for the alert. can someone confirm if any customer PII is in that bucket?

aj: on it. running quick sample listing to grep for keys/creds.

aj: quick scan: majority are compressed logs + backup manifests. found a few `.sql` dumps from 2024-09-12, sampling shows internal identifiers but no obvious PII. sending sample to maya via DM.

maya: ok proceed with containment first — assume sensitive until proven otherwise. containment steps: 1) remove public binding from bucket, 2) restrict KMS key policy to required service accounts only, 3) rotate KMS key or create new key + re-encrypt, 4) collect access logs and list objects accessed in last 30d.

leo: agree. I'm doing step 1 now. command I'll run:
```
gsutil iam ch -d allUsers:objectViewer gs://redwood-backups-logs-prod
```
I'll also set uniform bucket-level access if not enabled:
```
gsutil uniformbucketlevelaccess set on gs://redwood-backups-logs-prod
```

oncall: pinging pagerduty and opening INC ticket: INC-2026-178. notified legal and compliance.

sarah: please include list of impacted services and customers in the ticket. legal wants to know if any regulated data might be involved.

aj: containment update: removed allUsers binding, set UBLA on the bucket. running `gsutil ls -L gs://redwood-backups-logs-prod | head` to confirm ACLs. will paste snippet in thread when done.

aj: snippet:
```
ACL: Owner: project-owners@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
ACL: Uniform bucket-level access: Enabled
IAM Members: [serviceAccount:backup-runner@rdw-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com, serviceAccount:archiver@rdw-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com]
```

maya: good. now KMS. who has admin on that key? looks like terraform applied `members = ["domain:devs@redwood.com"]` and accidentally also `allAuthenticatedUsers` in an older policy. we need to remove any broad bindings and create a new key.

leo: I can remove the broad binding now:
```
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding rdw-backup-key --location=global --keyring=backup-keys --member="allAuthenticatedUsers" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter" --project=rdw-infra
```
But note: if we remove bindings, services using the key may fail. recommend creating a replacement key and rekeying backups, then rotate.

ryan: I'll spin up a short lived key and update backup-runner SA to use it for new backups, then re-encrypt older objects asynchronously. we should also revoke any service account keys that look suspicious.

maya: agreed. prioritize: (A) stop further public exposure, (B) prevent key misuse (remove broad members), (C) snapshot current state for forensics (bucket list + object metadata + KMS policy + IAM policy), (D) rotate and re-encrypt, (E) audit logs for access and exfil attempts.

aj: collected logs pointers: `projects/rdw-infra/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fdata_access` for storage and `cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity` for KMS. running queries for `protoPayload.methodName="storage.objects.get" AND resourceName:"redwood-backups-logs-prod"` and will share results.

oncall: PD notes: INC-2026-178 created, severity P2 -> escalating to P1 if we find confirmed egress. ticket includes runbook checklist and owners: maya (sec lead), aj (infra), leo (sre), ryan (devops). legal: @sarah.

maya: quick ask — do we have any signs of external IPs downloading many files? aj/leo to check VPC flow logs or storage access logs.

aj: preliminary logging shows repeated `storage.objects.get` from 3 distinct external IPs between 2026-11-01T03:00Z and 2026-11-01T04:00Z, ~1200 GETs. IPs are not internal GCP ranges. marking as likely exfil.

sarah: legal requests timeframe and list of potentially impacted customer IDs, plus whether backups included full DB dumps. please add to ticket.

leo: containment: temporarily disabled the KMS key by removing `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` bindings for non-essential accounts; left only `backup-runner` and `archiver` SAs. note: disabling whole key not trivial; we prefer scoped policy change + create new key.

ryan: started rekey job: create key `rdw-backup-key-rot1`, update backup-runner SA, queue re-encrypt workers. estimate 2h for manifests and metadata, 8h for full re-encrypt of 1.5M objects — will prioritize the `.sql` dumps.

maya: good progress. next steps: - full access log export to secure bucket for forensics - capture object versioning details - rotate any external creds that had access to bucket - review terraform to prevent `allUsers` in future (pre-commit hook) - create alert to detect public IAM bindings on buckets and KMS keys.

aj: terraform fix: adding a sentinel check and CI test to prevent `allUsers` or `allAuthenticatedUsers` in `google_storage_bucket_iam_binding` and `google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding`. will send PR shortly.

oncall: update: PD escalated to P1 due to external GETs and likely exfil. communication leads: maya + sarah to draft customer/legal notifications.

maya: drafting notification. initial plan: notify affected customers with scope summary, mitigation steps, and offer follow-up. legal to approve.

ryan: work item list created in INC ticket: REKEY-1 (create new key), REKEY-2 (re-encrypt priority objects), TF-1 (prevent bad IAM), LOG-1 (export logs), FOR-1 (forensic snapshot). assigning owners.

maya: containment confirmation: public binding removed, KMS broad members removed, PD ticket open, rekey job started. next: full investigation and postmortem. thanks team. :thumbsup: 

aj: I'll post final containment evidence (gsutil & gcloud outputs) to the ticket in 15m.

leo: adding postmortem owner — maya for sec analysis, aj for infra changes, ryan for CI guardrails. scheduled incident review tomorrow 10:00 PT.

sarah: legal will prepare the standard notification template, send to maya for approval.

alerts-bot: Note: alert cleared for public binding on bucket `redwood-backups-logs-prod` (condition no longer matched).
